This resource is built and maintained by the Data Diversity Lab at the University of Arizona.

## The gap this fills

Several studies have shown that machine learning can assign provisional risk categories
to unassessed and Data Deficient species, with accuracies close to expert assessment for
the threatened and non threatened distinction. Each of those studies released its
predictions as supplementary material for one taxonomic group at one point in time.

## Relationship to IUCN

We are not affiliated with IUCN. This site stores and serves no IUCN Red List data.
Every species page links to the IUCN entry so that the authoritative assessment.
The IUCN Red List is only used under its terms for training and validating our models
